title: Bring the CRM's hosting (Amplify app d15sc1sptohtqb) under infrastructure-as-code
description: The Amplify app d15sc1sptohtqb that serves the CRM frontend at prospectus.anth.us was created manually, with a GitHub connection, in papyrus-production. Ryan's rule (2026-10-20): nothing is manually configured; everything is infrastructure as code. The backend is already CDK deployed by this app's ampx pipeline-deploy, but the app itself, its GitHub connection, branch settings, domain association and rewrite rules (infra/hosting-settings.json, infra/branch-settings.json) are not defined in code. Target: define the CRM hosting in IaC (for example the same private S3 and CloudFront pattern as the Anthus One portal in infra/lib/portal-hosting.ts, published by BucketDeployment) so nothing depends on a hand-made app or GitHub connection, with a reviewed cutover plan for prospectus.anth.us that avoids downtime, and then retire the manual app. Not implemented here; the portal hosting PR (claude/portal-hosting-iac) removes the second-Amplify-app idea and leaves the CRM exactly as it is. New persistent IAM or security resources need concrete approval first.
